summary.zh: 前王朝通论中常出现的中心（含纳卡达遗址本身）；Midant-Reynes、Hoffman、Bard 提供地名与分期入口；未登记专报前不编造器物清单。
summary.en: Predynastic center often named in surveys (including Naqada itself); oriented via Midant-Reynes, Hoffman, and Bard; no invented assemblages without a registered site monograph.
